{{Quote|I'm just a supply officer. I can barely shoot straight.|Brundle|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Brundle''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Cresh]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to retrieve supplies stolen by the [[White Maw]] pirates.
